checks: 對話說有五個樣品要送驗；未確認的是接觸電阻，圖表指定 B 台，A/C/D 分別是阻燃、溫度循環與外殼尺寸。 正式題號、口述題幹與兩模式的對話範圍均核對；英中題意和各選項解析已校對。

activeQuestion.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which bench should receive the five samples?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請看圖表。五件樣品應送到哪個測試工作台？

options.whyZh: A 工作台做阻燃測試。
B 工作台測量接觸電阻，正是尚未確認的項目。
C 工作台做溫度循環測試。
D 工作台測量外殼尺寸；對話說尺寸已吻合。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 樣品是為了補做接觸電阻測試；圖表中這項測試對應 B 工作台。
activeQuestion.evidence: “We have not checked the contact resistance yet.” → Contact resistance: Bench B.

group.title: Confirming a connector alternative
group.passage:
Woman: The original connector will not arrive until next month. Could we use the alternative listed in the component database?
Man: Its dimensions match, but we have not checked the contact resistance yet. Please ask the lab to test it first.
Woman: Understood. I will send five samples to the lab today and keep the purchase order on hold.
Man: Good. We can decide after the results come back on Friday.
group.passageZh:
女：原本的連接器下個月才會到。我們能用零件資料庫列出的替代品嗎？
男：尺寸吻合，但我們還沒檢查接觸電阻。請先請實驗室測試。
女：了解。我今天會送五個樣品到實驗室，並暫緩採購單。
男：很好。星期五結果回來後，我們再決定。
